verified_examples.evidence: Public state has Pareidolia, Smiley Face and Photograph, but no jokers_not_in_estimates warning. The scorer tests printed ranks for face-card effects and does not apply Pareidolia. Played 9S/9H/3S/3H score 44 chips x 35 mult = 1540 when the face effects are applied, matching the actual outcome.

The Pillar, Raised Fist, only debuffed cards held after the selected play. The current Raised Fist rule adds rank-derived Mult without checking held-card debuff. The recording reports no unsupported scorer warning. Exact fix should be verified against game mechanics before changing the scorer.
